hypothesis: Diversified liquid asset-class ETFs with positive medium-to-long horizon trends will, as a portfolio, outperform a static 60/40 benchmark on a drawdown-adjusted basis after conservative costs because information diffusion, institutional rebalancing, and behavioral underreaction create persistent trends across asset classes.
expected_sign: long assets with at least two positive trailing total-return horizons; otherwise cash
prediction_frequency: monthly at final common trading-day close
execution: IBKR paper execution no earlier than the next common regular trading session; live raw prices for order sizing and reconciliation
research_data_boundary: certified point-in-time total-return data; broker execution data are not substituted for historical research certification
eligibility: at least two of three total returns are strictly positive
sizing: positive-vote confidence divided by trailing 63-day annualized volatility, normalized, 15% single-ETF cap, 35% asset-class cap, residual cash, no leverage

transaction_costs.paper_evaluation: actual IBKR-reported commissions and fill slippage are recorded and compared with the frozen research model

sample_policy.genuine_oos: IBKR paper trading after strategy freeze

predeclared_kill_criteria: Any point-in-time, adjusted-price, coverage, or execution-timing defect
Any IBKR contract qualification ambiguity or inability to reconcile target, order, fill, and final position
Net validation or historical-holdout CAGR is non-positive
Net historical-holdout excess return versus 60/40 is non-positive
Primary excess-return t-stat is below 2.0 or fails to exceed the current tournament noise ceiling by at least 0.25
Performance becomes non-positive at 10 bps one-way costs
One additional trading-day execution delay eliminates historical-holdout excess return
One calendar year contributes more than 50% of total net profit
IBKR shadow or paper reconciliation produces an unresolved state mismatch
Any post-result parameter or execution rescue is proposed
standing_rules: All robustness variants count in the global trial ledger
No broker activation or safety-gate bypass from candidate code
No production integration before lockbox and independent reproduction
